title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-008
doc_notes: This document is a collection of archival correspondence and internal memoranda regarding public information requests for the FAA's investigation into the November 17, 1986, JAL cargo jet UFO sighting.

encounters.summary: JAL Captain Kenjyu Terauchi reported his Boeing 747 cargo jet was shadowed by two belts of light and a huge spaceship the size of two aircraft carriers while crossing into Alaska.
